$comment: Monosai grammar difficulty presets. Authored for Monosai and dedicated to the public domain (CC0-1.0). Presets are the only grammar profile surface; see docs/decisions/0008-grammar-profile-presets.md and docs/decisions/0014-remove-grammar-rule-catalog.md. Names never contain a JLPT level; the caption records where patterns are conventionally taught. Japanese patterns are written literally as prose sent to the model.

presets.captionEn: the first patterns in any course
presets.descriptionEn: Single short sentences, one idea each.
presets.exampleJa: 私は毎朝七時に起きます。
presets.exampleEn: I get up at seven every morning.
presets.promptGuidance: Write below JLPT N5 complexity, at the level of a learner's first few weeks. Every sentence is a single clause of roughly 6-14 characters expressing one idea, with no clauses joined together. Use only: the polite copula です and ではありません; polite present 〜ます and 〜ません; the particles は, が, を, に, で, と, も, の, か; 〜があります／〜います; and adjectives used as predicates (おいしいです, 大きいです). Do not use past tense, the て-form, 〜たい, 〜から, 〜とき, conditionals, potential, passive, causative, volitional, relative clauses, or any conjunction joining two clauses. Keep subject matter concrete and physical. These patterns are examples of the level, not a list to work through.

presets.descriptionEn: Short sentences that can join two ideas.
presets.exampleJa: 朝ごはんを食べてから、学校へ行きました。
presets.exampleEn: After eating breakfast, I went to school.
presets.promptGuidance: Write at roughly JLPT N5 complexity; everything simpler remains available. Short sentences, typically 10-20 characters, of one clause or two joined ones. Now available in addition to the starter patterns: plain past 〜た and polite 〜ました／〜ませんでした, plain negative 〜ない, the て-form for joining clauses and for 〜てください／〜ています／〜てもいいです, 〜たい, 〜から (because), 〜が／〜けれど (but), 〜とき, 〜だけ, 〜より〜のほうが, 〜ことができます, 〜なければなりません, 〜になります／〜くなります. Still avoid passive, causative, volitional, conditionals (〜ば, 〜たら, 〜なら), and relative clauses modifying a noun. These patterns are examples of the level, not a list to work through.

presets.descriptionEn: Ordinary writing with conditionals and describing clauses.
presets.exampleJa: 友達に借りた本を読んでみたら、思ったより面白かった。
presets.exampleEn: When I tried reading the book I borrowed from a friend, it was more interesting than I expected.
presets.promptGuidance: Write at roughly JLPT N4 complexity; everything simpler remains available. Sentences of one or two clauses, typically 15-35 characters. Natural at this level: conditionals 〜たら, 〜ば, 〜と, 〜なら; potential and volitional forms; 〜てあげる／〜てくれる／〜てもらう; 〜ておく, 〜てしまう, 〜てみる; conjecture 〜かもしれない, 〜だろう, 〜はずだ, 〜ようだ, 〜らしい; connectives 〜ながら, 〜ので, 〜のに, 〜し; short relative clauses; 〜たことがある, 〜ほうがいい, 〜すぎる, 〜やすい／〜にくい. Avoid formal written connectives such as 〜において or 〜に基づいて, and any literary or idiomatic pattern. These are examples of the level, not targets to hit.

presets.descriptionEn: Longer sentences that explain, compare, and reason.
presets.exampleJa: 友達に貸した本がまだ返ってこないので、少し心配しています。
presets.exampleEn: The book I lent my friend still has not come back, so I am a little worried.
presets.promptGuidance: Write at roughly JLPT N3 complexity; everything simpler remains available. Sentences of up to three clauses, typically 25-50 characters, and abstract or explanatory subject matter is fine. Natural at this level: 〜わけだ, 〜ものだ, 〜べきだ, 〜に違いない, 〜はずがない, 〜ように, 〜ために, 〜によって, 〜に対して, 〜について, 〜として, 〜おかげで, 〜せいで, 〜うちに, 〜たびに, 〜っぽい, 〜がち, 〜ざるを得ない, 〜しかない, 〜だけでなく. Avoid heavily formal patterns such as 〜を問わず or 〜にもかかわらず, and literary forms such as 〜ゆえに or 〜べく. These are examples of the level, not targets to hit.

presets.descriptionEn: Written and formal style, with nested description.
presets.exampleJa: 調査結果に基づいて計画を見直すことになったものの、現場の反発は小さくなかった。
presets.exampleEn: Although the plan was to be revised based on the survey results, resistance on the ground was not small.
presets.promptGuidance: Write at roughly JLPT N2 complexity; everything simpler remains available. Longer sentences with nested modification are appropriate. Natural at this level: 〜において, 〜に関して, 〜に基づいて, 〜に沿って, 〜を通じて, 〜をめぐって, 〜を問わず, 〜にもかかわらず, 〜一方で, 〜反面, 〜次第, 〜だけに, 〜につれて, 〜に伴って, 〜かねない, 〜がたい, 〜わけにはいかない, 〜ものだから, 〜にしては. Avoid classical and literary forms such as 〜ゆえに, 〜べく, 〜ごとき, 〜や否や. These are examples of the level, not targets to hit.

presets.descriptionEn: No ceiling; literary and idiomatic writing is available.
presets.exampleJa: 彼は周囲の反対をものともせず、決めた道を歩き続けた。
presets.exampleEn: Undaunted by the opposition around him, he kept walking the path he had chosen.
presets.promptGuidance: Write without a complexity ceiling, at roughly JLPT N1 and below. Sentence length, clause nesting, register, and idiom are yours to choose to serve the story. Literary and idiomatic patterns are available where they fit, including 〜ゆえに, 〜べく, 〜ごとき, 〜や否や, 〜なり, 〜そばから, 〜ずくめ, 〜まみれ, 〜だらけ, 〜をものともせず, 〜をよそに, 〜に足る, 〜を禁じ得ない, 〜と相まって, 〜に即して, 〜もさることながら. Use them only where they read naturally; do not showcase them.

registerGuidance.spoken: Prefer casual spoken register, including contractions, where the scene allows.
